Project.title: Project
Project.description: A website project created in Canvas Visual Website Builder, supporting cloud save and 1-click live publishing.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the project creator.

name.description: Display name of the website project.

customCss.description: Custom CSS styles attached to the project.

isPublished.description: Whether the project is publicly viewable via its shareable live link.

root.description: Root BNode map representing the visual page hierarchy.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the project was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the project was last updated.

FormLead.title: FormLead
FormLead.description: A form submission from a Contact, Signup, or Booking form block on the canvas.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the site owner who owns this lead.

formType.description: Type of visual form block submitted.

message.description: Message, booking date, or additional details.

pageName.description: Name of the page where the form was submitted.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the lead was created.

/leads/{leadId}.description: Private form leads and submissions isolated per site owner.
